method: Matrix group medians use all 3 repetition-level values; median repetition P99 is not pooled P99. Soak whole/phase quantiles use all raw GET samples in that set by nearest rank ceil(N*p/100); ten-minute resource medians use all samples in each actual window, including the explicitly partial tail.

otter.limits: Classified request hit fraction uses observed Hits/(Hits+Misses); observed Hits and Misses per workload GET use outcome.requests. Unclassified means not counted in HIT/MISS, with no inferred actual cache state or cause; Bypass delta is separate. RuntimeVersion is configuration runtime, not PURGE epoch. RAM resident counts cache value bytes (including serialized Doc/HTTP metadata/manifest), not only HTTP body. RAM lookup includes metadata; process IO includes logs; device IO includes background/writeback. Percentiles use all raw GETs or their phase, not stage-P99 medians.

environment_provenance_limitation: 22 acceptance jobs explicitly record empty source_status; 4 checkedhey jobs omit that field. Source/binary/hey bindings are checked, but per-job clean checkout evidence is not recorded by checkedhey. Separate bootstrap/post-matrix/final checkout evidence does not fill those missing per-job fields.
delivery_commit_provenance: The measured binary/source is 5ccf32c. The later documentation delivery commit and its own CI are recorded externally by Git history and final GitHub Issue acceptance evidence; no self-referential SHA or pending CI value is fabricated here. Final document review remains a delivery gate.

metric_definitions.request_hit_fraction: Hits/(Hits+Misses), classified requests only; observed Hits/workload GET and Misses/workload GET reported separately.
metric_definitions.unclassified_workload_get_requests: workload GET minus Hits minus Misses; divide by workload GET for its fraction. Bypass is reported separately and does not explain the entire difference. The after-bypass residual is a separate raw projection.
metric_definitions.RAM.ResidentBytes: Serialized RAM cache value lengths, including Doc/HTTP metadata, manifests and body where present; external node/key estimated metadata separate; not pure HTTP body or RSS.

evidence.source_status_limitation: 20 acceptance jobs record clean status; 4 hey jobs omit it. Bootstrap and post-matrix checkout verified clean independently; per-job missing fields were not fabricated.

verified_inputs.raw_summary_scope: Root ran the frozen helper sequentially after all workloads stopped; final export contains audited summaries, not full requests/stages JSONL. Local report checks verify provenance and summary arithmetic; raw percentiles/counts are independently checked by root.

evidence.body_validation_scope: Checks recorded per-request client error/length/SHA evidence; body bytes were validated by clients at request time and are not stored or rehashed here.
